scientific_question: Can a saved tracking proposal remain available while the common Gaussian position measurement is rejected?
interpretation: A present tracking proposal does not guarantee an accepted quantitative Gaussian measurement.
limitations: The saved YOLO proposal trajectory is outside the frozen five-method run.
The diagnostic does not demonstrate tracker identity loss or compare the five methods on spots 2 and 4.
The uncalibrated amplitude gate is a measurement-acceptance rule, not a physical I(V) observable.
